statement: ∀ t : ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0), ∃ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ c : J p M (ev y v 0), (n : ℚ) • t = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] c
proof:
intro t
induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
| zero => exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, 0, by simp⟩
| tmul q c =>
  refine ⟨q.den, q.den_ne_zero, (q.num : R p) • c, ?_⟩
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, Rat.den_mul_eq_num]
  rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def]
| add a b ha hb =>
  obtain ⟨n, hn, c, hc⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨m, hm, d, hd⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨n * m, Nat.mul_ne_zero hn hm, m • c + n • d, ?_⟩
  rw [smul_add, Nat.cast_mul]
  calc
    ((n : ℚ) * m) • a + ((n : ℚ) * m) • b =
        (m : ℚ) • ((n : ℚ) • a) + (n : ℚ) • ((m : ℚ) • b) := by
          simp only [smul_smul]; rw [mul_comm (m : ℚ) n]
    _ = (m : ℚ) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] c) +
        (n : ℚ) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] d) := by rw [hc, hd]
    _ = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] (m • c + n • d) := by
      simp [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← TensorProduct.tmul_smul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

  [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p →
    ((∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ scalarRing p ↔ ∃ a b, ¬↑p ∣ b ∧ q = ↑a / ↑b) ∧
        ((∃ ι, iotaSpec p M ι ∧ Function.Injective ⇑ι ∧ ι.range = L p M) ∧
            Nonempty (Module.Basis (Ix l) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
              Submodule.span ℂ ↑M = ⊤ ∧
                (∀ (r : ℕ), Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r)) ∧
                  Preserves M x ∧
                    Preserves M y ∧
                      Preserves M h ∧
                        (∀ (r : ℕ), (∀ u ∈ L p M, (divided x r) u ∈ L p M) ∧ ∀ u ∈ L p M, (divided y r) u ∈ L p M) ∧
                          (∀ u ∈ L p M, x u ∈ L p M ∧ y u ∈ L p M ∧ h u ∈ L p M) ∧
                            (∃ fx fy fh, LiftOf M x fx ∧ LiftOf M y fy ∧ LiftOf M h fh) ∧
                              ∃ DX DY, ∀ (r : ℕ), LiftOf M (divided x r) (DX r) ∧ LiftOf M (divided y r) (DY r)) ∧
          (∀ (B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V),
              (∀ (i : Ix l), B i = ev y v ↑i) →
                divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat = matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
                  (∀ (i : Ix l),
                      divided x (l.toNat - ↑i) * (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) =
                        matrixUnit B i (Fin.last l.toNat)) ∧
                    (∀ (j : Ix l),
                        divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat * divided y (l.toNat - ↑j) =
                          ↑(l.toNat.choose ↑j) • matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) j) ∧
                      ∀ (j : Ix l), IsUnit ↑(l.toNat.choose ↑j)) ∧
            ∀ (B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V),

                ∀ (i j : Ix l),

                        (divided x (l.toNat - ↑i) * (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) *
                          divided y (l.toNat - ↑j)) ∧
                    ∀ u ∈ L p M, (matrixUnit B i j) u ∈ L p M) →
      (∀ (i : Ix l), J p M (ev y v ↑i) = J p M (ev y v 0)) ∧

            (J p M (ev y v 0)).FG ∧ J p M (ev y v 0) ≠ ⊥ →
        ∀ (t : ℚ ⊗[R p] ↥(J p M (ev y v 0))), ∃ n, n ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ c, ↑n • t = 1 ⊗ₜ[R p] c
